	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',

		DRUG_CLASS as string,

		FILLED_DATE as string,
		DOSAGE as string,
		PRESCRIBER_NPI as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		DAYS_SUPPLY,
		FILLED_BY_PHARMACY_NAME,
		GENERIC_NAME,
		DRUG_CLASS,
		PRESCRIBER_NAME_MIDDLE,
		NDC,
		CLAIM_NUMBER,
		UNIQUE_MEMBER_IDENTIFIER,
		BRAND_NAME,
